name: smwsprites-boogie-beta-sprite
title: Boogie (Beta Sprite)
description:
An interpretation of a scrapped beta sprite, popularly known as Boogie (seen in chr-stock-2-minidragon.OBJ).

This funny little man dances in place wherever he's placed in the level. If approached by the player, a player's fireball, a Yoshi fireball, or a thrown sprite, Boogie will teleport, reappearing elsewhere after a bit like a Magikoopa. Do note that Boogie won't follow the player around like a Magikoopa, though.

If the Extra Bit is set, Boogie will launch a projectile at the player upon reappearing.

This submission includes UberASM code that, if enabled, allows all active Boogie sprites to perform a special synchronized dance that can conjure a variety of customizable effects, from flipping the ON/OFF flag to killing the player. Both this function and the sprite itself are highly customizable, see the .asm files for more details.
